source_review.notes: Reviewed all ten references for identity, revision, and scope. RFC Editor records confirmed RFC 9110, RFC 9413, RFC 9745, RFC 8594, and RFC 6648; RFC 9745 is the March 2025 Standards Track Deprecation field specification, while RFC 8594 describes Sunset as a hint. The official Semantic Versioning page confirmed specification 2.0.0 and its public-API premise. Current Protocol Buffers guidance confirmed that binary wire-safe changes can still break application code and that deleted field identifiers must be reserved. Apache documentation confirmed the cited Avro 1.12.0 specification. Publisher and DOI records confirmed the Kleppmann book and Liskov-Wing paper. Mutable documentation was checked on 2026-09-06.

evidence: Reviewed producer, consumer, emitted-trace, accepted-trace, semantic predicate, directional compatibility, compatibility-matrix, deployed-version, required-consumer, evidence, and retirement notation before use.
Checked subset, conjunction, universal quantification, indexed matrix, finite status set, implication warnings, and directional arrow syntax for defined operands.
Confirmed traces explicitly include representation, inputs, outputs, timing, state transitions, errors, and side effects.
notation_and_syntax.notes: Compatibility terminology is directional and does not rely on ambiguous backward or forward labels.

evidence: Executed the four-pair compatibility matrix and independently confirmed P1-to-C1, P1-to-C2, and P2-to-C2 inclusion, with P2-to-C1 rejected for REFUNDED.
Confirmed the required envelope evaluates false because one of four required pairs is unsupported.
Reviewed all time, adoption, and percentage values as hypothetical scenario inputs rather than measured compatibility claims.
numerical_recomputation.notes: Finite value-set inclusion is an early representation check and is not treated as application-semantic compatibility.

evidence: Verified P_i to C_j is directional because W_i subset A_j does not imply W_j subset A_i or the reverse deployment relation.
Verified the envelope predicate requires every required Cartesian producer-consumer pair rather than only latest-to-latest.
Verified compatibility through adjacent transformations is not generally transitive because lossy or semantic transformations provide a counterexample.
symbolic_recomputation.notes: The semantic predicate S remains explicit, preventing parseability from being promoted to behavioral proof.

Reviewed ambiguous parsing, downgrade, unauthenticated negotiation, sensitive fields, public emergency alerts, assistive devices, and unsupported post-sunset access.

evidence: Reviewed directional set-inclusion reasoning and confirmed symmetry is not inferred.

The chapter supplies actionable matrix, gating, testing, notice, and retirement practices. Internal practitioner-oriented review only.

pedagogical_review.notes: Verified graduate-depth distinction among seven compatibility dimensions, a directional relation and envelope, eighteen distinct misconceptions, one reproducible matrix, ten varied worked examples with explicit conclusions, and five progressive exercises with complete answers ending in an unfamiliar public emergency-alert transfer.

limitations: Internal evidence record only; no external academic or practitioner review is claimed. Source checks, structural validation, formal set review, hypothetical cases, and one local Python execution do not validate an external contract population, enumerate all traces, prove semantic compatibility, authorize a sunset, certify a protocol or product, or provide public-safety, emergency, accessibility, medical, legal, privacy, security, financial, procurement, or regulatory approval.
